apps.localizedDescription:
AR Tools for FRC! Connect to the simulator or robot and view it on the field in real-time. View the field in life-size or miniature!

Works best on devices with a LIDAR sensor, but other devices are supported.

versions.localizedDescription:
The following are the highlights of the changes since 0.0.1. For a complete changelog, read the release notes on [github](https://github.com/nab138/GearGlimpseRevolution/releases).

New Features:
- Game piece (note) visualization
- Trajectory visualization
- View FMS Data & Command scheduler in floating windows above the field
- Proof-of-concept AprilTag detection (will be used for field alignment in the future)
- Custom Robots and more defaults
- Translucent or invisible field options
- Many, many bug fixes
